title: Koro Ka Wachokore
stanzas: Koro ka wachokore Ni mondo wahing Yesu,
Wanapar Yesu Kristo, Wanayiee gi chunywa;
Koro wahing Yesu, Ma notho e Kalwari.
Ka wachamo makate ni, Kwamadho kikombe ni,
Wanahing ringre Jawar, Ma nogur e yath ni wan;
Wanahing remb Ruoth Yesu, Ma nochwere e Kalwari
Nyasachwa, ornwa Muchi, Mondo donji e chunya;
Koro wahing Wuodi, Kaka En notho niji,
Kaka rembe nochwernwa, Ka notho e Kalwari.
